stories.title: Prozess in den Haag: Wird Hashim Thaçi heute als Kriegsverbrecher verurteilt?

en.title: Trial in The Hague: Will Hashim Thaçi be convicted as a war criminal today?
en.summary: A tribunal in The Hague is delivering its verdict today in the trial of Kosovo's former president after 234 hearing days and testimony from over 270 witnesses. The judgment carries implications for how the 1999 NATO intervention is interpreted.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran: Alle Vorbands steigen nach Macklemore-Eklat aus Tour aus

en.title: Ed Sheeran: All opening acts withdraw from tour after Macklemore scandal
en.summary: Four bands and performers, including the brother of Billie Eilish, are leaving Ed Sheeran's tour following backlash over rapper Macklemore's pro-Palestine statements made during his appearances.

stories.title: Prozess gegen Thaci: Wird Kosovos Ex-Präsident verurteilt?

en.title: Trial against Thaci: Will Kosovo's ex-president be convicted?
en.summary: A special tribunal in The Hague is ruling today on whether Kosovo's former president Hashim Thaci committed war crimes while leading the country to independence with the Kosovo Liberation Army.

stories.title: „Free Palestine“-Protest: Ed Sheeran verteidigt sich nach Tour-Rauswurf von Macklemore

en.title: "Free Palestine" protest: Ed Sheeran defends himself after Macklemore removed from tour
en.summary: Ed Sheeran has removed rapper Macklemore from his tour due to pro-Palestinian remarks, and the popstar is now explaining the circumstances while facing continued criticism from other artists.

stories.title: Supporting acts pull out of Ed Sheeran's tour over dropping Macklemore

en.title: Supporting acts pull out of Ed Sheeran's tour over dropping Macklemore
en.summary: Macklemore was removed from Ed Sheeran's tour following pro-Palestinian statements, with accusations of antisemitism involved. Sheeran attributed the decision to tour promoters rather than himself.

stories.title: USA-Newsblog: Kennedy Center wird laut Trump umgehend geschlossen

en.title: USA News Blog: Kennedy Center to be closed immediately according to Trump
en.summary: The US President sought to place his name on the famous cultural center in Washington, but courts have blocked this action multiple times. He is now attempting to shut down the facility for an extended period.

stories.title: Kennedy Center: Von Donald Trump eingesetzte Führung beschließt Schließung

en.title: Kennedy Center: Leadership appointed by Donald Trump decides on closure
en.summary: The renowned Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C. is set to close immediately, citing necessary renovation work. Trump previously wanted to have his name displayed at the venue.

stories.title: Kulturzentrum in Washington: Trump droht mit Aus für das Kennedy Center

en.title: Cultural Center in Washington: Trump threatens to end Kennedy Center
en.summary: The Kennedy Center has decided on immediate closure for renovations. A federal judge again prohibited placing Trump's name on the building's facade. Trump is now threatening to eliminate the cultural center.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran: Veranstalter entschied laut über Macklemore-Aus bei Tour

en.title: Ed Sheeran: Organizer decided on Macklemore's removal from tour
en.summary: US rapper Macklemore left Ed Sheeran's tour following pro-Palestinian remarks in the opening act. Sheeran has commented on the situation and explained his approach to public political expression.

en.summary: Chancellor Merz will not travel to the UN General Assembly next week due to domestic political discussions and state elections scheduled for the weekend. His presence in Berlin is considered necessary.

en.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz is canceling his planned trip to the UN General Assembly in the United States next week to address domestic political matters in Berlin following parliamentary elections.

en.summary: US autonomous ride-hailing company Waymo and Allianz Partners plan to collaborate on developing a European robotaxi business. The companies have outlined their planned initiatives.

en.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is pressuring the Bank of Japan to raise interest rates in an effort to reduce pressure on US bond yields. His underlying problem persists despite expected Japanese policy changes.

en.summary: Berlin-based tax technology companies are raising millions to automate accounting work for AI agents. Investors believe artificial intelligence can address the sector's skilled labor shortage.

en.title: Interest Rates: How Far Will the Fed Go with Its Rate Decision After the Yield Increase?
en.summary: Rising bond yields are prompting investors to reconsider US Federal Reserve monetary policy. Some rate increases could be tolerated by stock markets, though conditions may tighten further.
